# Eden

> Eden is a self-hostable working prototype for persistent AI agents, conversations, workspaces, media, and optional external integrations.

- `/eden-overview.md`: portable overview
- `/llms-full.txt`: longer feature and privacy guide
- `/agents`: agent directory for the current deployment
- `/sessions`: conversations available to the signed-in viewer
- `/studio`: configured media tools
- `/channels`: configured external conversation integrations
- `/skills`: agent skill catalog

Availability varies by deployment. This checkpoint is not production-ready. Do not infer public signup, pricing, provider access, or visibility of authenticated resources.
